title: Core: AS2 getter/setter accessors (get/set)
description: Test compilation of AS2 getter/setter syntax: class Foo { get name():String { return _name; } set name(v:String) { _name = v; } }. Also test Object.prototype.__defineGetter__ and __defineSetter__ usage. Test that compiled bytecode contains the property name string and ActionDefineFunction2 (0x8E) for the getter/setter bodies. Test that get/set as identifiers (not keywords) also work.
